method: For all 105 explicit Swift object link inputs without Ninja depfile records, query exact Ninja object edges and recursively query their .swiftmodule dependency nodes. Hash all existing declared file inputs. No compiler command was run.
scopeLimit: This closes exact Ninja-declared file and .swiftmodule edges for the 105 Swift object nodes that lack ordinary depfile records. All 106 unique declared file inputs exist and are hashed; six order-only cmake_object_order_depends_target_* nodes are CMake phony scheduling edges, not missing files. It does not prove every Swift compiler implicit import, all Xcode tool binaries/resources, generator execution closure, license applicability, clean recipient rebuild, or release qualification.
